sloka: दृष्ट्वा न खल्वसि क्रुद्धो मामिहानवकुण्ठिताम् ।निर्गतां नगरद्वारात् पद्भ्यामेवागतां प्रभो ।। ६.११४.६२ ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā na khalvasi kruddho māmihānavakuṇṭhitām ।nirgatāṁ nagaradvārāt padbhyāmevāgatāṁ prabho ।। 6.114.62 ।।

translations.english: "You are leaving me, a desperate one, stricken, crying. Why are you desiring to go? Why are you not replying to me?"
